items.snippet:

items.snippet:
Long answers on Claude on web and desktop now stream ~4x smoother.

We rebuilt the streaming renderer to only touch what's still changing, so a long reply stalls 9x less on a slower laptop, its worst freeze is 4.5x shorter, and on a 120Hz MacBook it holds 120fps start to finish. https://t.co/huomk33

items.title:
Perf win of the day: Claude Code CLI now uses 2x less CPU at p99.

Bun's garbage collector was running on a fixed timer, so it would kick in mid-turn and steal CPU right when Claude Code was busiest.
items.snippet:
Perf win of the day: Claude Code CLI now uses 2x less CPU at p99.

Bun's garbage collector was running on a fixed timer, so it would kick in mid-turn and steal CPU right when Claude Code was busiest. Now it waits until the process is idle. https://t.co/icGc35LDQs
